raw:
I had a baked potato with turkey chili for dinner, out on the porch after work. There was a spoonful of yogurt on top—the chili was on the potato, and then the yogurt on that. I think of it as a potato, but with the turkey chili it’s really a whole meal. The yogurt is the little bit I remember particularly.

I work as a supply clerk at an aquarium shop. That’s the work I’d come home from. But you asked about dinner—I remember eating it on the porch more than I remember what I was thinking about.
